summary: Master the art of selling with our Sales 101 course. Learn core principles and techniques to boost your sales skills and drive success in your career.
lede: Sales 101: Core Principles and Techniques turns selling into a practical, repeatable skill rather than a matter of natural talent. Learn to open conversations comfortably, uncover buyer needs, qualify prospects, and communicate the value of suitable solutions. Build a structured approach to follow-up, objection handling, negotiation, and closing. The course applies to selling products, services, training, donor programs, and internal initiatives, helping you pursue outcomes such as accepted proposals, signed contracts, renewals, and lasting partnerships.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need foundational sales skills to sell ideas, products, services, or programs effectively and confidently.
audience: New sales representatives and entry-level business development
modules: Sales Fundamentals and the Modern Buyer
Building Your Sales Process (From Lead to Close)
Discovery Skills That Uncover Real Needs
prerequisites: No prior sales experience is required, but participants should have a willingness to actively engage and apply the techniques discussed. A basic understanding of your organization's offerings will be beneficial.
